import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
servers = {'baseline': root/'artifacts/baselines/b066540/war-relay',
           'candidate': root/'artifacts/baselines/close-inline/war-relay'}
client = root/'artifacts/baselines/e2d7cf9/inspection'
output = root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-close-single-pair.json'
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record = {'scope': 'Sequential fresh native servers with four I/O workers and default limits, identical frozen client, server CPUs 0-3 and client CPUs 4-7. Three repetitions; case order rotates and baseline/candidate order alternates. 8192 idle rooms, one private pair (one active source worker), 1KiB values, window 16. Private has no reconnects; churn adds eight reconnect workers; management also adds two HTTP inspectors at 100 requests/s each. Phase gates verify full bodies, IDs, FIFO, Close/EOF and exact counters/resources. No compilation, profiling or other load tests overlap timing. Candidate changes peer-Close flushing and blocked-Close handling only.',
          'source_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),
          'source_diff': subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','src/server.rs'],cwd=root,text=True),
          'new_test_source': (root/'src/server/close_tests.rs').read_text(),
          'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'driver_sha256': sha(__file__),
          'binaries': {k:{'path':str(v),'sha256':sha(v)} for k,v in servers.items()},
          'client_sha256':sha(client),
          'helper_sha256':{k:sha(root/'scripts'/k) for k in ['inspection.py','benchmark.py']},
          'cases':[], 'passed':False}
for repetition in range(1,4):
    names=['private','churn','management']; start=(repetition-1)%len(names)
    for name in names[start:]+names[:start]:
        for kind in (['baseline','candidate'] if repetition%2 else ['candidate','baseline']):
            trace=output.with_name(f'{output.stem}-{name}-{kind}-{repetition}.json')
            cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/inspection.py'),'--server',str(servers[kind]),
                 '--client',str(client),'--seconds','8','--mode','http' if name=='management' else 'none',
                 '--pairs','1','--churn-workers','0' if name=='private' else '8','--output',str(trace)]
            run=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=100)
            data=json.loads(trace.read_text())
            assert run.returncode==0 and data['passed'],run.stdout+run.stderr
            assert data['server_sha256']==record['binaries'][kind]['sha256']
            assert data['client_sha256']==record['client_sha256']
            assert data['runner_sha256']==record['helper_sha256']['inspection.py']
            assert not data['profile_diagnostic']
            mixed=data['mixed']
            row={'kind':kind,'workload':name,'repetition':repetition,'trace':str(trace.relative_to(root)),
                 'trace_sha256':sha(trace),'passed':True,
                 'healthy':mixed['healthy']['per_second'],'healthy_p99_ms':mixed['healthy']['p99_upper_ms'],
                 'churn':mixed['churn']['per_second'],'churn_p99_ms':mixed['churn']['p99_upper_ms'],
                 'inspection':mixed['inspection']['per_second'],'inspection_p99_ms':mixed['inspection']['p99_upper_ms'],
                 'cpu_seconds_per_wall_second':mixed['server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second'],
                 'rss_measured_mib':data['events'][1]['process']['VmRSS']/1024}
            record['cases'].append(row)
            output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
record['medians']={}
for name in ['private','churn','management']:
    for kind in servers:
        rows=[r for r in record['cases'] if r['kind']==kind and r['workload']==name]
        keys=['healthy','healthy_p99_ms','churn','churn_p99_ms','inspection','inspection_p99_ms','cpu_seconds_per_wall_second','rss_measured_mib']
        summary={k:statistics.median(r[k] for r in rows) for k in keys}
        summary['ranges']={k:[min(r[k] for r in rows),max(r[k] for r in rows)] for k in ['healthy','churn']}
        record['medians'][name+'/'+kind]=summary
record['passed']=True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'medians':record['medians']}),flush=True)
